entries.description: Continuation of a listing from the previous page describing a community of three lesbians on 17 acres with housing, utilities, camping, woods, and farm land. They offer outdoor and cultural activities and welcome new members, non-lesbian women, and girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: holistic health, survival skills, yoga, and organic gardening. Winter activities include skiing (x-country and downhill), horse drawn sleigh rides, cozy fireplace, music and dance. entries.description: A community of five disabled lesbians on 21 acres in Monticello, NY, working to create recreation and independent living for disabled people. They have housing, plumbing, electricity, camping space, woods, and farm land, and welcome new members, non-lesbian women, and children.
entries.raw_text: THE BEACHTREE RD 1 Box 98, Monticello, NY 12701 (914)794-6121. Disabled lesbians trying to build recreation — independent living for disabled. Land will be opening to disabled men within next two years. We welcome women, donations, work exchange, no space in house available now. Possible openings in May. (No smoking in house). We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs. We have/are: 5 lesbians, 21 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address is the land. num_residents is 5 from '5 lesbians' and 'women living on the land'. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as 5 lesbians live on the land and welcome new members/residents. Focus 'Disabled women' from 'Disabled lesbians trying to build recreation — independent living for disabled.' Males are not coded because land will not open to disabled men for two years ('Land will be opening to disabled men within next two years'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, and Boy children from 'girl and boy children, nonlesbian women'.

entries.description: An individual lesbian owner with 22 undeveloped acres in north central Pennsylvania, seeking people to develop the land in exchange for a long-term lease.
entries.raw_text: SUSAN STONE 124 Maplewood Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19144. I have 22 acres of land in north central PA. There is a spring site, but it needs to be developed. The land is ½ wooded and ½ clear. Electricity is available. There are no improvements to the property. I would be interested in having people develop the land in return for a long term lease. I welcome: letters. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 22 acres, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: No community name given; listed under Susan Stone. Contact address is in Philadelphia while land is in 'north central PA'. Land has no improvements, so num_residents is 0. Type is Private/Individual Land (owned by one lesbian). Accepted groups coded as Lesbian women from LC context and '1 lesbian'.

entries.description: A community of ten lesbians on 20 acres aiming to be self-sufficient and politically/spiritually conscious, hosting retreats, workshops, and rituals. They welcome new members, girl children, boy children on limited weekends, and non-lesbian women who accept lesbian identification and the exclusion of men.
entries.raw_text: TURTLE LAND FOR WIMMIN 719 N Irving St, Arlington, VA 22201 (703)527-7396. Our goal is to create a diverse, fun, spiritually and politically conscious community living in harmony with nature and as self-sufficient as possible. Some retreats, workshops, music, rituals, etc. are going on already. A one room hexagon cabin should be finished by Summer '83. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children (only the 2nd weekend of each month), nonlesbian women who accept that men are not welcome and accept our lesbian identification, dogs. We have/are: 10 lesbians, 20 acres, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Mailing address is in Arlington, VA; land_state inferred as VA. num_residents is 10 from '10 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative. Boy children coded with condition ('only the 2nd weekend of each month'). Focuses: Spirituality/ritual from 'spiritually... rituals', Farming/self-sufficiency from 'as self-sufficient as possible', Workshops/education from 'retreats, workshops'.

entries.description: A single lesbian owner building a house on 50 isolated acres in Pittsboro, NC, seeking to create a haven for older lesbians and welcoming new members and girl children.
entries.raw_text: DUFFY Z BAUM PO Box 678, Carrboro, NC 27510 (919)942-5340. I own 50 acres of land in Pittsboro, NC. I am building a house on the land and also have an old house on the land. I do not live on my land but hope to by next summer. I am anxious to have other women join me on my land. The land is quite isolated and has some nice big old trees. I'd like to be a haven for older dykes. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 50 acres, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land (questionable).
entries.notes: Listed under Duffy Z Baum with no separate community name. Land location explicitly given as 'in Pittsboro, NC'. num_residents is 0 because 'I do not live on my land but hope to by next summer'. Type is Private/Individual Land under the rule that an owner not living on the land remains private land even when welcoming new members. Focus Older women from 'haven for older dykes'.

entries.description: A substance-free farm on 100 acres in Luttrell, TN, home to two members and two renters, which houses and supports the Tennessee Lesbian Archives and welcomes short-term visitors and girl children.
entries.raw_text: OKRA RIDGE FARM Rt 2 Box 252, Luttrell, TN 37779 (615)992-8423. Currently two members and two renters. Drug/alcohol-free space. Support and house the Tennessee Lesbian Archives. Visitors welcome for 1-3 days, but WRITE OR CALL FIRST; be prepared to work and contribute financially if you can. No smoking in main house or Archives. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 100 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address is the land. num_residents is 4 based on 'We have/are: 4 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land', consistent with 'two members and two renters' living there. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as 4 women reside and work on the land. Focuses: Recovery/substance-free from 'Drug/alcohol-free space', Archives/cultural work from 'Support and house the Tennessee Lesbian Archives'.

entries.description: An evolving alternative women's community with 300 acres (including 250 acres of woods and 30 acres of farmland) near Monticello, KY, welcoming new members, non-lesbian women, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: SPIRAL PO Box 337, Monticello, KY 42633 (606)348-5215. Spiral in essence is change. Spiral is in the process of creating an alternative wimmins community. We welcome constructive input/feedback to aide in our growth. Prefer wimmin write or call before visit. We welcome: new members, girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 12 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians, 300 acres, camping space, woods (250 acres), farmland (30 acres).
entries.notes: PO box so street address not land; land_state inferred as KY from mailing address. num_residents left blank because the listing does not state 'women living on the land' or equivalent. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('in the process of creating an alternative wimmins community. We welcome: new members'). Accepted groups from 'new members, girl children, nonlesbian women'.

entries.description: Two lesbians living on 2.3 acres with an organic garden in Granville, OH, envisioning a community through collective work. They accept short-term visitors, girl and boy children, non-lesbian women, and non-oppressive men (not overnight).
entries.raw_text: ADLAI NEUBAUER & KAREN HAMM 3634 Loudon St, Granville, OH 43023 (614)587-4527. We are only beginning. We have a small piece of land and the start of an organic garden. We envision a community of women supporting each other emotionally, spiritually and financially through responsible collective work. Visitors should plan to stay a maximum of two nights unless a work exchange or other arrangements are made (2 week advance notice preferred). No drug addicts/alcoholics, kleptomaniacs, or other disrespectful people welcome. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, non oppressive males (not overnight), dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2.3 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Street address is the land where the women live. Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule: lived on by two lesbians; while they envision community, they are not actively recruiting new permanent members/residents (only visitors for max two nights). num_residents is 2 from '2 lesbians' and 'women living on the land'. Focus Recovery/substance-free from 'No drug addicts/alcoholics'. Accepted groups include Gay men and Non-gay men with restriction ('non oppressive males (not overnight)').

entries.community_name: SUSAN B ANTHONY MEMORIAL UNREST HOME
entries.description: Two lesbians living on 150 acres in southeast Ohio seeking feminist pioneers to begin a women's rural community, especially encouraging older feminists. They welcome new members, non-lesbian women, older women, and children during July.
entries.raw_text: SUSAN B ANTHONY MEMORIAL UNREST HOME Rt 1 Box 215, Millfield, OH 45761. Feminist pioneers wanted to begin women's rural community in southeast Ohio. Send long SASE for brochure. Older feminists especially encouraged to respond. We welcome written (or taped) inquiries and correspondence. No drop ins or surprise telephone requests for overnight accommodations. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children (only during July), nonlesbian women, older women especially welcome. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, primitive camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Rural route address is the land. num_residents is 2 from '2 lesbians' and 'women living on the land'. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because the two women on the land are actively recruiting new members ('Feminist pioneers wanted to begin women's rural community', 'We welcome: new members/residents'). Focus Older women from 'Older feminists especially encouraged to respond' and 'older women especially welcome'. Children welcomed with condition ('only during July').
